payload.title: README is Gatsby starter boilerplate (Netlify, contradictory instructions)
payload.description:
**Problem**
The Tactus-web README is the Gatsby starter boilerplate, mentions Netlify, and contradicts how the site is actually built and deployed (Amplify).

**Evidence**
README.md in AnthusAI/Tactus-web (audit finding; see also amplify.yml).

**Fix**
Rewrite the README: what the site is, local dev, build, Amplify deploy, content layout.

**How to verify**
README contains no starter boilerplate or Netlify references and its commands run on a fresh clone.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
